BiblicalUsage: Argob is a district of Bashan, the region of the giant king Og, with threescore great cities fenced with high walls. Moses takes all the region of Argob, gives it to the half tribe of Manasseh, and Solomon's officers still list the region of Argob among his twelve districts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Argob shows that the land of the giants becomes the inheritance of God's people, and the walled cities of Og end up on Solomon's tax list.
